title: Car Fleet
description:
Cars start at distinct positions before `target` and move toward it. `position[i]` and `speed[i]` describe one car. Cars cannot pass; a car that catches another joins its fleet and travels at the slowest speed in that fleet. Count the fleets that reach the target. Cars that meet exactly at the target count as one fleet.

## Examples

```text
Input: target = 12, position = [10,8,0,5,3], speed = [2,4,1,1,3]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: target = 10, position = [3], speed = [3]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `position.length == speed.length == n`, where `1 <= n <= 10^5`
- `0 < target <= 10^6`
- `0 <= position[i] < target`; all positions are unique
- `0 < speed[i] <= 10^6`
